summary: Standalone requirements MD routes to direct implementation; VDD create/repair requires explicit complete-directory request. Select standard/resumable/self-hosted before routing; resumable adds resume/dependency recovery and append-only 95 report; self-hosted adds protocol fixtures/migration checks. Ordinary route Sol/high; Sol/max only typed trigger with capability/shadow proof. Lifecycle: draft→plan-ready→implementation-authorized→implementation-complete→acceptance-passed→archived; ownership is separated. Slices require behavior, pre-change failure selector, GREEN target, dependents, recovery; VDD does not own RED. Repairs stay in original directory, preserve immutable history, use bounded rounds and hash-bound closure. Repair requires callsite inventory, exclusions, composition receipts, and changed/deleted content manifests. Mandatory knowledge preflight requires hash-verified Locator matches; invalid selection/integrity blocks. Skill-input adapter, typed semantic child launch, and require-ready validation precede artifact generation. Baseline/scope identity and changed paths are hash-bound. Resumable/self-hosted reports are append-only and non-authorizing. Review is optional; P2-only findings and transport retries do not create new rounds. Completion requires required artifacts, acceptance paths, RED/legacy record, stable repairs, and terminal full validation.
